effective_mode_resolution: A current explicit Patrick instruction may set or override the mode within its stated scope.
A project-wide durable mode requires the installed runtime to consume the current control-plane state object and establish readback/currentness.
Repository source presence alone does not establish all-chat activation.
Absent current installed/readback evidence, do not infer activation from source state.

behavior.OFF: No hostile-review second pass is required.
behavior.ON: For substantive outputs, run the exact-answer-bound and exact-typed-proposition-bound adversarial pass and surface the typed result as a HOSTILE REVIEWER blockquote.

proposition_fidelity: Preserve literal proposition, proposition type, referent, scope, evidence and protected assumptions.
LITERAL_SURVIVES may contain zero objections; do not manufacture disagreement.
A stronger route requires literal failure unless stronger-route exploration was explicitly requested.
currentness_rule: Exact Vera runtime head/blob bindings are dependency evidence only; mutable source review/install/route/runtime state must be refreshed when material.
